title: The Sealed Filing
who: registry clerk at Basin Registry Services
want: Deliver a sealed lien filing to Basin Registry Services before the receiving counter closes.
at_stake: The filing lapses, the yard's first right passes to another creditor, and the client holds your crew to the delay.
complication: A witness will not go until a trusted officer's word comes on a live line. (complications.md, courier 6)

approaches.label: Offer to stand by while she calls
Trace the filing's seal at the counter
Carry it to the mooring office instead
approaches.npc_reaction: says the mooring office is not a registry

Offer to stand by while she calls.clean: the client pays your crew on receipt of the stamped filing
Offer to stand by while she calls.cost: the client pays your crew but takes a share off for the wait
Offer to stand by while she calls.fail: your crew pays the registry's late-filing fee

Trace the filing's seal at the counter.clean: the clerk records that your crew's seal check was clean
Trace the filing's seal at the counter.cost: your crew pays to have a seal re-struck at the counter
Trace the filing's seal at the counter.fail: the clerk notes your crew as the carrier of a damaged seal

Carry it to the mooring office instead.clean: the mooring office speaks well of your crew to the yard
Carry it to the mooring office instead.cost: your crew pays the mooring office's handling fee
Carry it to the mooring office instead.fail: your crew pays the fee for a wrong-office delivery
